done_when: Both tests pass inside the full gate run on a clean machine. They isolate their own temp directories or provide git identity.
need: When run standalone, test_wiring_scan.py (18 tests) and test_mts_signal.py (53 tests) pass OK. When run inside the parallel gate (run_all_tests.py --quick), they fail. test_wiring_scan asserts a temp folder is not a repo, but the gate may leave a .git in %TEMP%. test_mts_signal fails 'git commit -q -m signals: start' with empty stderr, likely because the shared %TEMP% git environment lacks user.name/user.email or is locked by parallel shards.
title: Gate: test_wiring_scan and test_mts_signal fail inside shared %TEMP%
